incoming.name: History of Wikipedia
incoming.excerpt: Independently, Ben Kovitz, a computer programmer and regular on Ward Cunningham's wiki (the WikiWikiWeb), introduced Sanger to wikis over dinner on January 2, 2001.

incoming.name: Wikipedia
incoming.excerpt: Wales and Sanger attribute the concept of using a wiki to Ward Cunningham's WikiWikiWeb or Portland Pattern Repository.

outgoing.name: Electrical engineering
outgoing.excerpt: "Ward" Cunningham received his bachelor's degree in interdisciplinary engineering (electrical engineering and computer science) and his master's degree in computer science from Purdue University.

outgoing.name: United States
outgoing.excerpt: "Ward" Cunningham (born May 26, 1949) is the American computer programmer who invented the wiki.
